title: Marketing and Communications
description:
Marketing and Communications: Location: Tunbridge Wells

Salary: £30,000-£40,000 per annum - dependant on experience

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Are you a creative and proactive with 2 years plus experience in marketing, managing your role? looking to develop your career within a fast-paced events environment?

Personable, professional with high level communication skills- working alonside 3 directors and external business relations.

We're recruiting for an established international events business operating across the health, personal care and pharmaceutical sectors. This is a fantastic opportunity to take ownership of marketing and communications activity for a portfolio of UK-based conferences and exhibitions.

Working closely with the Communications Manager, you'll help deliver multi-channel marketing campaigns designed to increase brand awareness, generate leads and engage key audiences.

The Role

You will be involved across the full marketing mix, combining content creation, email marketing, social media, digital campaigns and event promotion.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Delivering marketing campaigns across email, social media, direct mail and web.
- Creating engaging and persuasive content for digital channels, websites and printed materials.
- Managing and executing email marketing campaigns and reporting on performance.
- Creating high-quality marketing collateral using Canva or similar design tools.
- Supporting the sales team with effective marketing materials.
- Maintaining communications plans and marketing calendars for individual events.
- Supporting market research, data analysis and reporting.
- Bringing fresh ideas to increase audience engagement and brand awareness.
- Attending events as part of the on-site team and capturing content for future campaigns.

About You

We're looking for someone who is curious, organised and keen to develop. You'll enjoy taking ownership of your work while collaborating effectively with colleagues.

You'll ideally have:
- At least 2 year's plus experience within a marketing role, ideally within events, B2 B marketing or a similar environment.
- Leading and able to demonstrate independent work within your marketing career to date.
- Experience delivering marketing campaigns and communications plans.
- Hands-on email marketing experience, including campaign creation and reporting.
- Experience creating digital marketing assets using Canva or similar.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Confidence managing social media accounts and producing engaging content, including video.
- Experience using AI tools for ideas and drafting while maintaining brand voice and quality.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Competent Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience or knowledge of digital marketing and/or a Marketing-related degree would be advantageous but is not essential.

Why Apply? This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious marketer who wants more than simply ticking off tasks. You'll have the chance to test ideas, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your marketing activity while building your career within the events sector.

Salary: £30,000-£40,000 per annum

Location: Tunbridge Wells Office Based

Full-time Permanent

title: Marketing Content Executive
company: Mission Aviation Fellowship UK - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing Content Executive

Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) is seeking a creative Marketing Content Executive to develop engaging, audience-focused content that supports our fundraising, supporter engagement and brand objectives.

This is a rewarding opportunity for a talented marketing copywriter to bring our mission and impact to life through powerful storytelling, creating content that inspires people to engage, give and advocate for our life-changing work.

Location: Folkestone, Kent (with hybrid working - two days a week in the office)

Rewards: Salary of £32,510.27, plus a generous pension scheme, annual leave entitlement, and other great benefits and professional growth opportunities

Contract: Permanent, full-time

The Role

As a Marketing Content Executive, you will create engaging, audience-focused content that supports our fundraising, supporter engagement and brand objectives across digital and offline channels.

Specifically, you will write, edit and adapt content for campaigns, supporter journeys, emails, web pages, social media and printed materials, ensuring communications are creative, consistent and tailored to different audiences.

Working closely with Marketing, Fundraising and Donor Experience colleagues, you will develop content for supporter journeys, appeals and stewardship, helping to increase engagement and donor income and strengthen supporter relationships.

Additionally, you will:
- Support case study development and story gathering
- Brief designers and videographers where required
- Set up campaign tracking and accurate tagging across channels
- Maintain marketing content and support our asset register
- Assist with supporter and fundraising events

About You

To be considered as a Marketing Content Executive, you will need:
- Proven marketing and fundraising copywriting and proofreading experience across web, email, social media and print
- Experience of collaborating across teams, such as Fundraising, Communications and Programmes
- Experience of working within an agile framework, including familiarity with scrum and sprint methodologies
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with technical expertise in marketing copywriting
- The ability to tailor messaging to different audiences
- Confidence using project management and content scheduling tools
- A degree or equivalent professional experience

About Us

Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) is a Christian organisation that uses light aircraft to deliver practical help, physical healing and spiritual hope to some of the world's most remote and inaccessible communities.

For 80 years, MAF has been working in partnership with hundreds of other organisations to enable access to medical care, education, livelihood training and long-term support in over 24 low-income countries.

They believe that every community, however remote, should have access to the essentials of life - that's why MAF's flights are a lifeline, not a luxury.

The Benefits
- Salary of £32,510.27 per annum
- Annual leave entitlement of 22 days per year plus 8 paid public holidays per year
- Non-contributory pension scheme (10% of salary); employees may make voluntary additional contributions
- Death in service payment
- Flexible working policy
- Access to our Employee Assistance Programme

This is an impactful opportunity for a marketing and fundraising copywriter with experience creating content across digital and offline channels to join our purpose-driven organisation.

You'll have the perfect platform to put your creativity and storytelling skills to powerful use, bringing incredible stories to life and creating content that inspires people to engage with, advocate for and support our work.

And, with the flexibility of our hybrid working model, you'll have greater control over your working week, giving you more freedom to balance your career with the people, passions and priorities that matter to you.

Christian Values, Beliefs and Ethos:

As a Christian mission, MAF UK seeks staff who share in the evangelical Christian values and beliefs as described in the mission, purpose, values, and beliefs statements. All staff will be required to actively support and demonstrate the Christian values of the organisation and to take part in organisational activities such as staff devotions, prayer meetings, and fellowship days.

Other organisations may call this role Content Executive, Marketing Executive, Content Marketing Executive, Marketing Communications Executive, Fundraising Content Executive, Digital Content Executive, Content & Campaigns Executive, Marketing Copywriter, Fundraising Copywriter, or Content Officer.

The closing date for this role is 7th October 2026.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

West Malling, Kent

£30,000

Office Based
- Are you a Marketing Executive who loves creating content and bringing ideas to life?
- Are you the sort of person who uses your initiative, asks questions and gets stuck in rather than waiting to be told what to do?
- Would you like a varied marketing role where one minute you could be discussing ideas with the MD and the next editing content in Photoshop or working on a new campaign?

We are recruiting for a growing specialist business looking for a talented and ambitious Marketing Executive to join its small, collaborative marketing team.

This is a varied role and would suit someone who enjoys being involved across all areas of marketing rather than being restricted to one particular channel.

Strong copywriting skills are essential, but you certainly don't need to arrive knowing everything. The company is much more interested in finding someone with the right attitude, creativity, curiosity and potential who is keen to learn and develop.

You could be writing a case study in the morning, speaking to internal teams about lead performance later that day and then jumping into Photoshop to make an adjustment to a brochure or social graphic.

There is a relatively flat structure, so you'll have exposure to people across the whole business and plenty of opportunity to contribute ideas.

What will you be doing?

Content & Copywriting

Writing will be a major part of the role, including:
- Blogs and articles
- Website content
- Case studies
- Partnership content
- Advertising editorials
- Email campaigns
- Social media content
- Landing pages and FAQs
- Campaign messaging

You'll need to be able to take information from different people within the business and turn it into clear, engaging content.

Campaigns & Email Marketing

Working closely with the Head of Marketing, you'll help plan and deliver campaigns across different channels.

This will include:
- Developing customer lifecycle email campaigns
- Creating follow-up campaigns
- Producing newsletters
- Supporting lead generation activity
- Working with internal teams to understand how leads and campaigns are performing
- Developing future campaigns from initial idea through to delivery

As you develop within the role, there will be the opportunity to take greater ownership of campaigns yourself.

Social Media & Video

You'll help create engaging social content across the company's channels, including:
- Writing social posts and captions
- Planning informative and more light-hearted Reels
- Organising filming with people across the business
- Helping film and edit video content
- Editing longer-form videos
- Supporting the launch and development of the company's TikTok presence

Previous TikTok experience would be a bonus, but isn't essential.

Design

You don't need to be a graphic designer, but you will need some basic practical design ability.

The company already has established templates and branding, so you'll mainly be making adjustments and creating marketing assets using tools such as:
- Adobe Photoshop
- InDesign
- Premiere Pro

This could include social graphics, web banners, flyers, brochures, adverts and video content.

A good eye for detail will be important.

Website, SEO & Digital Marketing

You'll also get involved with the performance of the company website and wider digital marketing activity.

This could include:
- Reviewing website performance and identifying areas for improvement
- Basic SEO optimisation
- Keyword monitoring
- Website landing pages
- Metadata and FAQs
- Content clusters
- SEO and AEO content
- Google Analytics and other Google marketing tools
- SEMrush
- Supporting Google PPC activity
- Monitoring links, traffic and campaign performance

You don't need to be an SEO or PPC specialist, but a basic understanding would be useful.

Events & Advertising

There will also be opportunities to support:
- Events and webinars
- Pre and post-event marketing
- Follow-up campaigns
- Advertising partners
- Advertising content
- Campaign reporting

Occasional attendance at events may be required.

What are we looking for?

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who can write.

You'll need strong copywriting skills and the ability to adapt your writing for different audiences and channels.

We're also looking for someone who is:
- Proactive and comfortable using their initiative
- Naturally curious
- Full of ideas
- Happy speaking to people across a business
- Organised and able to manage several things at once
- Comfortable asking questions and asking for help when needed
- Keen to learn
- Comfortable receiving feedback and coaching
- Able to work at pace
- Creative with a good eye for detail

You'll ideally have around 1-2 years' marketing experience, although the quality of your experience and your potential are more important than simply ticking every box.

Experience could come from either a B2 B or B2 C environment.

A degree in Marketing, English Literature, Media, Journalism, History or a similar subject could also be useful, particularly where you can demonstrate strong written communication skills.

What don't you need?

You don't need to have done every single part of this job before.

If you've got exposure to around 75% of the role, can demonstrate excellent writing ability and have the personality and initiative to learn the rest, we'd still really like to hear from you.

This is a role for somebody who wants to become a genuinely well-rounded marketer.

You'll work closely with an experienced Head of Marketing, have exposure across the business and be encouraged to learn, test ideas and gradually take ownership of more campaigns and channels.

If you're looking for a varied marketing role where you'll be able to contribute ideas, develop your skills and make an impact, we'd love to hear from you.
